mentions.name: Telegram project-tracking bot
mentions.description: A Telegram bot that helps the author stay on top of the projects they want to do, combining an LLM with the Todoist MCP plus scheduling and carefully crafted prompts to manage their project tasks.
mentions.problem: Staying on top of the projects the author wants to do.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a little telegram (for now) bot to help me stay on top of the projects I want to do.

Basically LLM + Todoist MCP + some scheduling and clever prompts.
